json_schema.description: Appendix B item 2, the write-ahead: recorded UNDER THE CLAIM and BEFORE any worktree, branch or session exists. It is what makes a spawn re-checkable, which is the only reason claims.go's lease takeover is safe — a second handler arriving after a takeover finds this and reconciles against local reality instead of spawning again. Closed by spawn_committed or spawn_failed. NOT spillable: an intent in a local file is invisible to the reconciler on every other host, and a contract event that only exists locally reads as work nobody is doing. host_affinity names the host that is about to create the local resource, so worktree-bound follow-ups are claimable only there.
